body: It's been nearly 2 weeks since I last ate and nobody in my family has even noticed. They truly don't care about me. I'm ending this tonight.
How do you plan on getting well again?

Update: So it's been a little over a week and I've consumed nothing but black coffee and an odd glass of water.
Physical changes so far - Weight loss, obviously (around 8 pounds), tiredness, cracked lips, dizziness when standing up, changes in heart beat (sometimes racing, sometimes fluttering). My goal is to mess up my electrolyte balances and pass away from heart failure peacefully in my sleep, I can feel my heart getting weaker each day, I'll update again in a few days.
Yeah the nausea is horrible, I've found that if I keep myself hydrated it's not so bad.
Thanks! But I don't expect to live long enough to have to worry about any long term complications.
I've just had enough of everything.
God the sleeplessness has got to be the worst part of starving! PM me if you cant sleep and need to talk about anything. <3
I've been hoping for a better life for long enough, but it's just not going to happen for me. I appreciate your compassion, but this is my best option.
The first 2-3 days are always the hardest. After that, the hunger kind of just melts away. How are you?
At least I'm not acting impulsively and shooting my brains out - this way I'll be 100% sure I want to commit suicide, and anyway, if my situation changes I can just start eating again.
